title: Does heart-rate–ST-depression coupling transfer? An uncertain incremental prediction result across two angiography cohorts
abstract: In Cleveland-to-Hungary independent-center transport (303 training,293 target records), adding a peak-heart-rate×ST-depression product to flexible marginal clinical/exercise predictors reduced Brier score by 0.001658, but joint patient-bootstrap95% interval for added-minus-baseline error [-0.022725,0.020365] did not establish incremental benefit.
